profile.headline: Software Engineer III | C#/.NET • Distributed Systems • Product Engineering | Content Creator & Community Builder
profile.summary:
As a Software Engineer specializing in the Microsoft ecosystem, I bring both technical depth and entrepreneurial versatility to every project. My experience across C#, .NET, Azure, SQL Server, REST APIs, distributed systems, and backend modernization has enabled me to build scalable platforms, optimize performance, and deliver high-impact solutions that support business growth.

I thrive in collaborative engineering environments where clear communication, ownership, and continuous improvement matter. Throughout my career, I’ve contributed to API modernization initiatives, performance optimization efforts, backend architecture improvements, and mentoring teammates while helping teams navigate complex technical challenges with practical solutions.

Beyond engineering, I’ve built a successful personal brand in the trading card game (TCG) space through content creation, coaching, and community leadership. I run a YouTube channel with 5,000+ subscribers, coach players through Metafy, and authored the Amazon bestselling book How to Win Cardfight Tournaments. These experiences have strengthened my skills in communication, teaching, business development, and audience engagement.

I’m always open to connecting with professionals in software engineering, platform/backend systems, SaaS, logistics, and entrepreneurship. Whether to collaborate, share ideas, or explore new opportunities.

positions.title: Software Engineer III
positions.description:
Joined C.H. Robinson to help build modern software solutions that support the logistics and supply chain industry.
 
Working as part of a collaborative, cross-functional Agile team developing Greenfield applications using modern Microsoft technologies. Contributing to the design and implementation of scalable solutions while partnering with product managers, UX designers, and engineers to deliver software that solves real customer and business challenges.
 
Key Areas: 
• Full-stack application development with .NET and React 
• RESTful API development and microservices 
• Cloud-native and event-driven architecture 
• SQL Server, Kafka, and distributed systems 
• AI-assisted software development and engineering workflows 
• Agile/Scrum collaboration with cross-functional teams 
• Product-focused engineering and continuous improvement 
 
Technologies:
 C#, .NET, ASP.NET Core, React, SQL Server, Kafka, Git, Azure DevOps, REST APIs, Agile, AI-assisted Development
positions.insights: Skills: Software Development · Software Design · Engineering

positions.title: YouTube Content Creator & Brand Owner — Commander Jaime
positions.description:
Competitive Strategy & Content Growth | Multi-TCG Creator | Brand Partnerships | Player Development & Community Impact

I run Commander Jaime, a competitive trading card game (TCG) brand focused on multi-TCG gameplay guides, official card reveals, and community mentorship. What began as a passion project in Cardfight!! Vanguard evolved into an established TCG brand recognized across multiple communities, supported by strong engagement metrics and ongoing brand partnerships.

Key Highlights:

🎥 Created and grew a YouTube channel to 5,500+ subscribers and 50,000+ watch hours, focused on high-level TCG gameplay and strategy

📘 Published How to Win Cardfight Tournaments — achieved Amazon Bestseller ranking within 1st week of release

🧠 Coached numerous players, leading to multiple regional tops and World Championship qualifications

🤝 Partnered with sponsors like Final Saga, Dueling Guard, 50 Cards, TCGplayer, and Trading Card Mint to promote products through authentic, community-driven content

💸 Delivered $8,000+ in product sales from a single long-form video for a sponsor, demonstrating strong influence and conversion power

🌊 Selected by Bushiroad to reveal an Aqua Force card world preview, reflecting recognition as a trusted voice in the community

✨ Collaborated with Elestrals TCG on an official card reveal, further expanding reach and recognition across the broader TCG landscape

🎙️ Hosted player interviews, creator collaborations, and community spotlights highlighting rising competitors and local stores

🌱 Built a growing audience and mentorship ecosystem rooted in competitive integrity, learning, and personal development
positions.insights: Skills: Social Media Marketing · Brand Development · Competitive Gaming · Community Development · Coaching & Mentoring

positions.title: E-Commerce Business Partner
positions.description:
Building an e-commerce business focused on driving online traffic and creating residual income streams through strategic partnerships.

Collaborate with experienced leaders and professionals across multiple industries, leveraging mentorship to develop business growth strategies.

Guide and support new team members in personal finance, entrepreneurship, and leadership development, fostering a growth-oriented environment.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Own development of C#/.NET Core backend services supporting global logistics pricing systems.

Reduced contract processing time from 32–48 minutes to under 2 minutes (~96% improvement) by resolving concurrency and logic bottlenecks.

Optimized SQL Server performance and EF Core queries, eliminating timeouts and improving reliability at scale.

Diagnosed and resolved critical system bottlenecks using profiling tools (Flame Graph, Call Tree, Performance Profiler).
positions.insights: Skills: Software Infrastructure · Software Industry · Engineering · Software Design

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed microservices for Oracle’s Public Key Infrastructure (PKI) to issue and manage OCI certificates, including logic for certificate chain verification, versioning, and lifecycle management.

Built and automated infrastructure using Terraform (IaC) and integrated with Java-based services, ensuring secure, scalable, and compliant deployments across global regions.

Enhanced service reliability by implementing deep health checks across production systems ahead of compliance deadlines, improving monitoring and fault detection capabilities.

Resolved critical customer issues by troubleshooting authentication and policy configuration problems, including direct Zoom sessions for complex cases—improving customer satisfaction and reducing escalation time.

Mentored new engineers through pair programming, bug fixes, and code reviews, accelerating onboarding and fostering confidence in production deployments.

Led on-call rotations to diagnose and mitigate production incidents, including expired certificate renewals in global regions—executed manual fixes under time constraints to prevent customer impact.

positions.title: Chicago Chapter Leader for Oracle Latinos Alliance
positions.description:
Supported initiatives to engage and grow the Oracle LatinX community, fostering professional development and inclusion within the organization.

Contributed to networking and volunteering events, helping members build connections, strengthen leadership skills, and create business impact.

Collaborated with chapter leaders to promote OLA’s mission of empowering LatinX employees through mentorship, career growth, and community engagement.

(Oracle Latinos Alliance is an Employee Resource Group focused on developing talent, building networks, and giving back to the community.)

Link to page: https://www.linkedin.com/groups/7057440/

positions.title: Software Developer 3
positions.description:
Currently, I'm on a team and help with bug fixes, implementing new features, and improving the software Epic used by insurance companies. At this level, I'm able to work independently or lead, mentor on a more frequent basis, and help design solutions. I have experience in people skills, being a leader, team morale, stress eliminator, and developing relationships.

I work mainly with Microsoft technologies such as Visual Studio, Azure DevOps, SQL Server, and Wix. Other technologies that I also work with are GitLab CI/CD, VMWare, and Internet Information Services (IIS).

I have experience in working with RESTful domain-driven ASP.NET MVC web services, SaaS, APIs, client-server models, and Wix/MSI solutions. I have experience with multiple design patterns such as Factory, Strategy, Builder, and more. I have experience with automation tests such as MSTests, Moq, & Integration tests. Have experience with using SQL Server 2008-2016 such as queries, indexes, stored procedures, transactions, encryption, migration, replication, and availability groups.

Languages I currently work with are C#, VB.NET, XML, and SQL.

I also work in an Agile Scrum environment.
